newsitem.title: USA: Remington Products Co Q3 operating income falls.
newsitem.headline: Remington Products Co Q3 operating income falls.

text.p: Remington Products Co LLC said Thursday that preliminary results show third quarter operating income of $4.5 million, down from $8.4 million for the comparable 1995 period.
For the nine months, the company reported an operating loss of $10.7 million, compared to an operating profit of $10.7 million in 1995.
For the quarter ended September 28, net sales fell to $61.7 million from $66.5 million for the third quarter of 1995.
For the nine months, net sales dropped to $143.1 million from $149.3 million in the 1995 period, the company said.

Remington said its 1996 nine-month operating loss included non-cash or non-recurring charges for the company's recapitalization in May 1996. The charges included $10.9 million of costs and obligations paid by the previous owners.
The company said Thursday that it expected fourth-quarter sales to be little changed from the same period of 1995. It saw fourth-quarter operating profits declining.

The company said its total debt balances as of September 28 were $171.8 million, consisting of $40.6 million under the credit facilities, $130.0 million of 11 percent senior subordinated notes and $1.2 million of other debt.
Cash balances were $300,000, and about $29.5 million was available under a revolving credit facility.
